what: Hover a thin italic uppercase title and the original text empties (transparent) while the same text appears at 1.35x in a graffiti typeface, centered in the same spot, instantly (no transition). It returns instantly when you leave

options.data-graffiti: Text to show as graffiti (element attribute) — same as the original text, line breaks kept as they are
options.--fx-scale: Graffiti text size multiplier (css variable), default 1.35 (original 100px title → 135px)
options.--kf-font-graffiti: Graffiti typeface — if the Skin has none, use the title typeface

use: Your big title here

from.where: All pages big titles and footer news titles — original [data-graffiti]:hover{color:transparent} · :after{content:attr(data-graffiti); font-family:Mostwanted; font-size 135/100 times; No opacity 0→1 transition}
